build.note: Kernel built from the source tree with the host gcc -m32 fallback because the i686-elf cross toolchain is absent. The dosrun change adds BIOS INT 10h AH=06h/07h text-window scrolling and bottom-row scrolling for DOS console output.

environment: QEMU i386, CPU 486, 64 MiB RAM, serial console; fresh 16 MiB FAT16 test images. Binaries and disk images remain outside the repository.

cases.name: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
observed: ZIP 2.00 starts the story and renders the title, West of House and the mailbox description.
look, open mailbox, read leaflet, north, inventory and score produce readable output.
save asks for a file name; ZORK1.SAV is written (13330 bytes) and reports OK.
quit, y and the final key return to the manios% shell prompt.
A fresh boot and restore of ZORK1.SAV reports OK; look returns to West of House.
The status line still clips the right side: only Moves is visible in some frames, and Score can be cut off. This is cosmetic for the tested commands.
A black rectangle remains at the bottom-right of the text screen.

cases.name: Adventure (350-point DECUS port)
observed: The game prints the welcome screen and asks Would you like instructions?
The instructions answer is read as a 20-character FORTRAN record. N followed by 19 spaces is accepted; an unpadded n, N, no or NO is rejected with Please answer the question.
look, inventory, north, quit and y work; the quit message reports a score of 32 out of a possible 350 using 4 turns and returns to the manios% shell prompt.

cases.name: Planetfall (Infocom Sampler demo)

story.note: Official 1984 Infocom Sampler. It contains a Planetfall sample alongside Zork I, Infidel and The Witness. The full commercial Planetfall story was not tested or committed.

observed: The sampler starts under ZIP 2.00 and JZIP and renders the introduction and the Hit RETURN prompt.

Entering planet selects the Planetfall sample. Under ZIP the text window is cleared to blue and the sample text is not readable; under JZIP only the first line (Briefly, here are the instructions for Planetfall...) appears at the bottom and the sample does not advance.

The result is recorded as Partial: selection works, but the Planetfall sample itself is not playable with the tested interpreter/display path. Full Planetfall gameplay is unverified for licensing and rendering reasons.

interpreter_results.zip200: Working for Zork I; selected as the text-adventure interpreter.
interpreter_results.jzip: Starts Zork I and the sampler, but status-line and screen formatting are poor and the sampler stalls after its first sample line.
interpreter_results.frotz255: Stops at OUT 0043h (PIT channel 0 control) before the game; unsupported runner gap.
interpreter_results.frotz253: Stops at OUT 0043h (PIT channel 0 control) before the game; unsupported runner gap.
interpreter_results.dzip: Stops at OUT 00F0h; unsupported runner gap.

limitations: The status line in Zork I still clips Score/Moves at the right edge.
A bottom-right black rectangle remains in the text display.
Frotz and DZIP need additional PIT/FPU or hardware support.
Planetfall full-game testing is blocked by licensing; only the official sampler demo was used.
The kernel was linked with the host gcc fallback, not the missing i686-elf cross toolchain.
